subject: baku
pitch:
Category: Fantastical creature.
Subject: baku, the dream-eating tapir spirit.
Style: ukiyo-e woodblock print.

spec.name: Baku, the Dream-Eater
spec.description: A stylized dream-eating tapir spirit in ukiyo-e woodblock style: an indigo barrel-bodied tapir with a short drooping trunk, a gold crescent moon on its brow, a flowing smoke mane down its spine, and pale dream wisps curling up into its nostrils.
spec.layout: Model space: +Y up, faces +Z, left is +X, feet on y = 0. From front (+Z) to back (-Z): the dream wisps (a pale smoke spiral and floating cloud puffs with gold stars and a glowing gold crescent moon, z 1.6 to 2.6, y 1.2 to 2.0) drift just ahead of the trunk tip. The head (z 1.05 to 2.0) is a chunky tapir skull at y 1.6 to 2.2: short trunk drooping forward-down to a flared nostril tip at [0, 1.42, 1.9], slightly open lower jaw with two small bone tusks, large gold-irised eyes on the skull sides, big dish ears tipped up to y 2.15, and a gold crescent moon emblem on the forehead. The body (z -1.45 to 1.2) is a wide barrel tapering gently at both ends, belly underside at y ~0.5, back crest at y ~1.6, with the neck rising from [0, 1.32, 0.72] to the head mount at [0, 1.66, 1.12]. Four short columnar legs (x = ±0.45, front pair centred at z 0.78, hind pair at z -0.72, gold hooves resting on y = 0) hold it square and calm in a rest pose. A smoke mane crest runs along the dorsal line from the forehead over the neck and back (mount maneSpine) into a thin ox-like tail dropping to [0, 0.62, -1.78], ending in a pale tuft tied with a gold band (z to -1.9). The ukiyo-e style shows everywhere as hard flat colour fields split by ink zig-zag edges (toon kit furEdge), gold wave-and-cloud emblems seated on shoulder and haunch, a small vermilion artist's-seal rectangle on the left flank, and low-poly faceted primitives throughout; the moon and stars glow softly (glow kit).

parts.builds: The barrel torso and neck. Sweep or loft one smooth low-poly body along catmull([0,1.15,-1.25],[0,1.05,-0.6],[0,1.05,0.2],[0,1.18,0.8],[0,1.32,0.72]) riding joints body and neck, with elliptical sections wider than tall: rx ~0.62 / ry ~0.55 through the mid and hips, 0.58 at the chest, 0.5 at the rump, rounding into the neck which continues as a tapering tube (radius 0.34 to 0.27) up to mount headRoot at [0,1.66,1.12] so the head part's skull overlaps it with no gap. The coat is a paint: toon-kit cel over furEdge with indigo above and cream below, split by a hard zig-zag edge inked in ink that runs around the flank at about n.y = -0.1 (belly, chin and leg-roots cream; back, sides and neck indigo), plus a broad indigoLight drift of stylized woodblock tone patches across the upper flank (paint with noise or patches, size ~0.3, same seed shared with nothing else). Add a small vermilion rectangular artist's-seal slab (like a woodblock stamp, ~0.07 x 0.1, ink-outlined) seated flat on the left flank near [0.55, 1.15, 0.1]. Seat one gold wave-cloud emblem per side: a flat extruded spiral-cloud medallion (~0.18 across, gold with goldPale inner line and ink rim) on the shoulder at mount shoulderL/shoulderR pushed to the surface, and a larger matching one on each haunch near [±0.55, 1.2, -0.85]. Along the dorsal line leave the crest skin clean between neck and tailRoot for the mane part, which sits on mount maneSpine. Nothing else on the torso.
parts.attaches: Neck tube ends at mount headRoot where the head part's skull begins; neck tube starts at mount neckRoot rising out of the chest sweep. Leg roots emerge from the barrel surface at mounts shoulderL/shoulderR/hipL/hipR (the legs part builds those limbs). Tail root and dorsal mane sit on the rump and spine at mounts tailRoot and maneSpine.

parts.builds: The whole head: skull, face, trunk, jaw, ears, eyes and brow emblem, riding joints head, jaw, trunkA, trunkB, trunkTip, earL, earR. Skull: a chunky rounded mass centred on mount headRoot, built from a scaled sphere or short loft (about 0.44 wide, 0.42 tall, 0.5 long, indigo on top, cream face below via the same furEdge family of paint or layered parts), tapering into a short blunt muzzle whose nose bridge ends at [0, 1.62, 1.5]. The trunk is the signature feature: sweep a chain through trunkA [0,1.64,1.48], trunkB [0,1.6,1.7] and trunkTip [0,1.42,1.88], radius 0.15 tapering to 0.07, cream on the underside and indigo on top with ink ridges as 4 or 5 thin dark rings (thin swept bands or stick rings) down its length; the tip flares into a soft tulip lip: a slightly wider disc with two small dark ink nostril discs facing forward-down, and a pair of cream lip curls. The lower jaw is a separate piece on joint jaw, posed open about 12 degrees (b.pose): a short blunt cream slab swept from the jaw joint forward to [0,1.5,1.62] with a cream chin and an ink mouth line where it meets the upper muzzle; two small upward-curving bone tusks (thin cones, bone colour, ink tips) sprout from the upper jaw sides at [±0.14, 1.57, 1.48]. Eyes read big from the front: on each skull side at [±0.17, 1.74, 1.3], a flattened ink almond (scaled sphere) with a gold iris disc, ink pupil and a small goldPale highlight dot, each backed by a cream eye-patch and topped with a thick ink brow stroke; angled slightly outward-forward. Ears: two large open dish ears on earL/earR, each an extruded rounded-leaf outline (~0.26 long, thickness tapering 0.03 to 0.008, smoothing 2) in ink-rimmed indigo outside with a rose inner face and cream rim, tilted up-and-out per the joint dir. Forehead emblem: a gold crescent moon (extruded crescent outline, ink outlined, gold with goldPale edge, glowing softly via kits/glow at strength ~1.2) seated flush on the brow at [0, 1.86, 1.26], tilted to face up-forward, with a tiny vermilion dot seal beneath it. Keep the face clear of clutter: nothing in front of the eyes.
parts.attaches: Skull base overlaps the neck tube at mount headRoot [0,1.66,1.12]; trunk tip at [0,1.42,1.9] is where the dreams part's inhaled wisp spiral terminates.

parts.builds: All four sturdy columnar legs riding the fourteen leg joints, planted square in a calm rest pose. Each front leg runs straight down through legFU*, legFL*, legFF* from mount shoulder* to the floor: an upper segment capsule (radius 0.16 to 0.14, indigo), a lower segment (radius 0.13, indigoDeep for a cool lower tone), an ink line ring at the knee, and a cream sock from mid-shin down. Each hind leg follows its three-bone chain through legHU*, legHK*, legHH*, legHF* (hip to knee, knee back to hock, hock down to the foot), same colour scheme with the hock joint carrying a small ink knee-cap disc. Feet: three-toed tapir hooves resting exactly on y = 0, each toe a small frustumBox or capsule (gold, ink outline line on the front face, creamShade sole pad) fanned ±22 degrees about the foot joint, with a gold cuff band ring at the ankle above them. Toe beans not needed; keep the feet chunky and simple so the gold hooves read as trim. Legs are identical between sides, mirrored in x; hind hooves land at z ~-0.74, front at z ~0.78.
parts.attaches: Each upper leg segment sinks into the barrel surface at mounts shoulderL/shoulderR (front) and hipL/hipR (hind); the tops of the upper capsules must be buried at least 0.12 into the body so no joint shows.

parts.builds: The smoke mane and the tail, riding joints tailBase, tailMid, tailTip plus the body/neck/head bones. The mane is the model's signature flowing feature: along the dorsal line from the forehead [0,2.0,1.15] over mount maneSpine [0,1.56,0] to mount tailRoot [0,1.32,-1.32], build two staggered rows of flame-like smoke blades sweeping up and back, each a thin swept spike or small membrane blade (height 0.16 to 0.28, root radius 0.03 to 0.015) coloured root-to-tip from indigoDeep through mist and mistWhite to goldPale tips, roughly 20 to 26 blades total, leaning backward 20 to 40 degrees so the crest streams behind; a few longer wisps (3 or 4, height 0.4) at the neck and rump carry the silhouette. Blades must root inside the body surface (bury 0.03) so nothing floats. The tail is a thin ox-like rod swept along the tail chain from mount tailRoot through tailMid to tailTip [0,0.62,-1.78], radius 0.085 to 0.04, ink coloured with a gold band ring at mid-tail; at the tip a tassel: a gold ring (small torus or band) plus a tuft of 8 to 10 pale cards (mistWhite with mist edges, size ~0.05 x 0.14, slight bend and vary) hanging down past the rod end to y ~0.45.
parts.attaches: Mane blades root along the torso's dorsal surface between the head and mounts tailRoot and maneSpine; the tail rod's first span buries into the rump at mount tailRoot [0,1.32,-1.32]; the foremost mane blades root on the head's crown just behind the moon emblem.

parts.builds: The dream being eaten, riding joints trunkA, trunkB, trunkTip and head. From the trunk tip [0,1.42,1.9] a spiral of pale smoke is drawn inward: sweep a spiral path (2 turns, pitch ~0.08, radius growing 0.05 to 0.12) that ends at the nostril tip, tube radius 0.035 to 0.012, colour mistDeep at the outer end blending to mistWhite at the mouth of the trunk. Around it float three low-poly cloud puffs at roughly [0.2, 1.55, 2.2], [-0.25, 1.75, 2.35] and [0.05, 1.5, 2.5], each a cluster of 3 or 4 overlapping squashed spheres or a small lathe dome, mistWhite tops with mistDeep undersides and a thin ink underside line like a woodblock outline. Each puff carries one small four-point star: a flat gold or vermilion extruded star (0.06 across, ink rimmed) seated on the puff's surface, and two or three loose gold stars drift between puffs; the moon: one larger gold crescent (extruded crescent outline ~0.3 across, gold with goldPale inner edge, ink rim, glowing via kits/glow at strength 1.3) floats highest at [0, 1.92, 2.45], facing forward. Everything in this part is light, airy and clearly otherworldly against the solid indigo tapir; nothing may touch the floor and nothing overlaps the ears or trunk geometry.
parts.attaches: The spiral's inner end seats exactly on the trunk's nostril tip at [0,1.42,1.9] (shared with the head part's trunk tip); the whole part floats free of every other part, entering the head's box only at that tip.
